en.headline: Free outdoor space installations remain at Salisbury Garden until 22 November
en.dek: Giant planet and aerospace displays form the free outdoor zone of the Fly Me to the Moon exhibition along the Tsim Sha Tsui waterfront.
body: Large-scale planet and space station art installations continue on free display at the central lawn of Salisbury Garden beside the Avenue of Stars in Tsim Sha Tsui as part of the Fly Me to the Moon: A 380,000 km Odyssey exhibition.

Organisers said the outdoor zone, presented in Hong Kong for the first time, features the works alongside a Moon-inspired merchandise area. The harbourfront setting provides daytime sea views and Victoria Harbour night scenery as backdrops.

The full exhibition, organised by IOIO Studio, runs until 22 November and also includes a ticketed indoor immersive section at K11 MUSEA. The outdoor installations at Salisbury Garden and the Avenue of Stars require no admission.
Visitors can walk the waterfront freely during the exhibition period. The display is scheduled to close on 22 November.

zh.headline: 梳士巴利花園戶外太空裝置展延續至11月22日
zh.dek: 「飛奔到月球」展覽的免費戶外區在尖沙咀海濱展示大型行星及航天藝術裝置。
body: 大型行星及空間站藝術裝置繼續在尖沙咀星光大道旁梳士巴利花園中央草坪免費展出，屬「飛奔到月球——38萬公里的旅行」展覽的一部分。
主辦方表示，這是相關裝置首次在香港展出，現場亦設有以月球為靈感的商品區。海濱位置日間可望海景，晚上則以維多利亞港夜景為背景。
展覽由IOIO Studio主辦，展期至11月22日，另在K11 MUSEA設有需購票的室內沉浸式展區。梳士巴利花園及星光大道的戶外裝置無需入場費。
市民及遊客可在展期內自由漫步海濱觀賞。展覽將於11月22日結束。
